lead: I'm Mohammed Amaan Khan, a B.Tech. Game Development student focused on gameplay programming and level design in Unity.
paragraphs: I am a Unity Developer with hands-on experience building gameplay systems
and UI in C# across 2D and 3D projects shipped to Google Play. I have a strong foundation in object-oriented programming
with a track record of taking design specs from concept to stable
I'm expanding toward technical game design: making gameplay systems and spaces work together clearly through deliberate prototyping and technical practice.
